question: Get orders with customer names
sql:
SELECT c.*, o.*
FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c."customerNumber" = o."customerNumber";

decomposition.intent: Retrieve joined data from customers + orders
joins: customers c JOIN orders o ON c."customerNumber" = o."customerNumber"
